keyTakeawayCard.gentle: In practice, this step introduces the Focusing Question as the tool for finding the next move with the most leverage. the method argues that a better question improves selection by turning scale into sequence, but the tool only works when the answer leads to action.
keyTakeawayCard.direct: broad ambition becomes leverage-seeking next-action choice.
keyTakeawayCard.competitive: Ask for the move that bends the rest of the work, then act before the question becomes hiding.
